news.title: New Common Processing Architecture Awards Announced
news.text: Mercury Systems announced receipt of fresh production awards tied to its common processing architecture portfolio.

news.title: RBC Capital Sets $55 Price Target
news.text: Analyst Ken Herbert at RBC Capital established a $55 price target for Mercury Systems, underscoring the company's processing technology positioning.

news.title: Additional Processing Architecture Contracts Secured
news.text: Mercury Systems received two more common processing architecture production awards, reinforcing demand for its embedded processing solutions.

news.title: Sensor Processing Agreements Expanded
news.text: Mercury expanded agreements with a major European defense prime, including a five-year sensor processing contract and broader MMIC supply commitments.

news.title: Fiscal 2025 Results Announcement Scheduled
news.text: The company set August 11, 2025, as the release date for its Q4 and full-year fiscal 2025 financial results.

news.title: Shares Jump on Strong Q4 Performance
news.text: Mercury Systems' stock surged 22.9% after Q4 results beat expectations thanks to a $30 million revenue pull-forward and strong bookings growth.

news.title: Strategic Agreements with AeroVironment
news.text: Mercury Systems signed new hardware production agreements with AeroVironment, strengthening collaboration on defense platforms.

news.title: European Defense Partnerships Expanded
news.text: Mercury entered two major agreements with a European defense prime to accelerate sensor processing subsystem production using HDS6605 boards.

news.title: Executive Insider Sell Transaction Disclosed
news.text: Vice President and CAO Douglas Munro sold 67 shares at $73.40 under a sell-to-cover program related to vested stock awards.

news.title: RBC Capital Upgrades to Outperform
news.text: RBC Capital upgraded Mercury Systems to Outperform and raised its price target from $55 to $90, citing strength in mission-critical processing.

news.title: Canaccord Initiates Coverage at Buy
news.text: Canaccord Genuity began coverage with a Buy rating and $88 price target, highlighting Mercury's role in defense electronics.

news.title: AI-Powered Threat Detection Demo Planned for AUSA
news.text: Mercury announced plans to showcase its AI-driven threat detection solution at AUSA 2025, underscoring continued innovation in defense AI.

news.title: Truist Boosts Target to $100
news.text: Truist Financial raised its price target to $100 while maintaining a Buy rating, signaling confidence in Mercury's turnaround trajectory.
